name: JG_ZZ_VAT_TRX_DETAILS
description: JG_ZZ_VAT_TRX_DETAILS contains all payment related transactions selected for tax reporting. Taxable transactions (invoices) are already marked as selected directly in  ZX repository itself, since payment related transactions have no tax impact, they are not stored in tax repository and they are marked as finally reported using this table. It can be used as a source for audits to provide information reported to the tax authorities at any point in time.
